reviewer.affiliation: Family member of the commissioning owner; no involvement in the UI's development

checklist.statement: Each states what it is (the Report)
checklist.note: Reviewer: "Every single report has a phrase 'Frozen Report' at the top of the screen"

checklist.statement: Each states what it is (the Dashboard)
checklist.note: Reviewer: "Every single Dashboard has phrases 'updates as new Results arrive' and 'Automatic refresh every5 seconds'"

checklist.statement: the Report shows the moment it was frozen
checklist.note: Reviewer: "I see the 'generated at ...' phrase, but there is no 'frozen at' phrase"

checklist.statement: Fails if: A viewer could take either for the other from what the UI shows (met = they cannot be taken for each other)
checklist.note: Reviewer: "They have different UI and names". Blind step 1 (before any evidence): chose B as the frozen Report (correct), cue: the words "Report" and "Frozen Report" at the top (as recorded by the owner), confidence: guessing.

notes: Form: plain-language questions (STEP-2, English) mapped to the checklist by the owner's assistant: Q1->1, Q2->2, Q3->3, Q4->4 ('No, they can't be mixed up' = met). Fixture deviation (UI sample instead of F-SIGNALS): reviewer says it does not change her answers. Reviewer comment: "In Reports, there is a phrase 'Current state may differ'. It may confuse users as the Report is frozen, but this phrase says that something can change." Reviewer's question during the review, verbatim: "Why do we have a phase 'Current state may differ; Report does not change. Open the Dashboard'. - Why should I open Dashboard? Why the state may differ if the Report is frozen?" Reviewer gave the date only; the time 00:00 local is a placeholder, not a recorded time. Evidence captured by an independent AI inspector (Gemini), run rui-inspection-r2, on a PC whose clock was one hour ahead of UTC.
